objective: Practice layout, sizing, typography through an inspectable interface.

expected_output: Build a sidebar, statistics cards, chart placeholders and a data table.
acceptance_criteria: Include the core structure for admin dashboard.
Check narrow and wide viewport behavior; preserve keyboard usability where relevant.
hints: Start with semantic HTML and a small set of utilities before polishing details.
Prefer standard utilities and theme tokens over arbitrary one-off values when they fit.
Use browser developer tools to confirm generated CSS and test acceptance criteria.
grading_method: Static required-string checks plus human review of rendering, responsiveness and accessibility. No learner code is executed by the CodeLeaf API.
retry_policy: Allow retries. Only the first successful completion of an activity should award platform-defined base XP; incorrect submissions do not award XP.
status_note: Draft exercise; verify static checks and expected behavior before publication.
